## Background
```{r,}
imvdata=read.csv(file="infant-mortality-vaccines.csv")




```

## INTRODUCTION/ STUDY QUESTION
Between vaccinated and non-vaccinated groups, who shows a more significant decline in child mortality?

## HYPOTHESIS
Infants that are vaccinated will show a more significant decline in mortality rates compared to those who are unvaccinated.

## VISUALIZATIONS
```{r}
# Libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Most basic bubble plot
ggplot(imvdata, aes(x=Year, y=Infant.mortality.rate, size = 102)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.7)
```


## TEST STATISTICS
```{r}
mortality_lm_year <- lm(Infant.mortality.rate ~ Year, data = imvdata)
 summary(mortality_lm_year)
```
Linear regression shows a resulting graph of the correlation between a response and predictor value.
